caseName: Sinatra v. New Jersey State Commission of Investigation
caseNameFull: Sinatra v. New Jersey State Commission of Investigation
attorneys: Bruce W. Kauffman and William T. Coleman, Jr., for applicant.
judges: Application, Are, Black, Consideration, Douglas, Granted, Should, That, Took

opinions.text:
Application for stay pending appeal to United States Court of Appeals denied.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Douglas, and Mr. Justice Marshall are of the opinion that the application should be granted. Mr. Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
